premises.text: Deskless workers lack employment systems built for their safety, payment, and help needs, and employers lack structure to meet those needs
premises.evidence_span: Current employment solutions are not actually built for these workers

premises.text: Two-way support delivered via text messaging gives deskless workers easy phone access without another app
premises.evidence_span: Antil delivers through the most accessible technology out there, text messaging

premises.text: Auto-resolution replies to FAQs using keyword capture, resolving most inbound questions automatically across many languages
premises.evidence_span: our auto-resolution feature resolves over 95% of the inbound questions automatically

premises.text: Managers can run surveys/campaigns and get summarized results while managing frontline conversation threads
premises.evidence_span: Managers can also set up a survey or run a campaign and we will summarize the results for you

premises.text: Advanced analytics (workplace health score, sentiment/psychometrics) surface disengagement and turnover risk before workers leave
premises.evidence_span: advanced analytics showing you the workplace health score

premises.text: Next product generation integrates via application, API, and existing HR platforms like SAP and messaging apps
premises.evidence_span: integration into the existing HR platforms like SAP and messaging applications

value.text: Bridge employees and employers to improve deskless-worker retention and connection
value.evidence_span: Our goal is to improve retention across your organization

secondary_value.text: Inclusive connectivity and access for the entire deskless workforce
secondary_value.evidence_span: Entel provides a complete inclusivity of the entire workforce
